name: How long does a custom kitchen remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom kitchen remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom kitchen remodel depends on its complexity and scope. A smaller, cosmetic update might be completed in 4-6 weeks, while a full custom renovation involving layout changes, custom cabinetry, and high-end finishes typically takes 8-16 weeks from demolition to completion. This timeframe includes design, material ordering, and construction. Unexpected issues or material delays can occasionally extend the project duration.
